items.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
items.summary: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.

items.title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
items.summary: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarter’s total losses, according to Hacken.

items.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

items.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
items.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

items.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
items.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

items.title: Can the SEC and CFTC’s pro-crypto rules be overturned? Legal opinion
items.summary: The SEC and the CFTC have issued a raft of pro-crypto rules recently. But will the rules hold up in court, and can they be easily rolled back by the “anti-crypto army”?

items.title: Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

items.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
items.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.
